title: Thai-Style Beef Skewers
description: Grilled beef skewers served with a spicy Thai-inspired sauce, perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, fish sauce, and lime juice
Add the sliced beef and marinate for at least 30 minutes
Thread the marinated beef onto skewers
Brush with veggie oil and season with chili flakes
Grill over medium-high heat for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked through
Serve immediately with your favorite Thai-inspired sauce
